requirements.description: User prefers properties near healthcare services for a senior day center. The request uses a proximity expression, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.

The user explicitly requests a gross floor area of at least 360 sqm. The 18-person capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The Turin location and proximity to healthcare are handled by the Location Agent, and the future CDIA use does not affect the current typology.

output.explanation: Filters offices ('Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 360 sqm, within 3.0 km of the supplied coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892), and healthcare proximity score >= 75. Energy class is not filtered, as requested. Results are ordered by distance from the location, nearest first. The 18-person capacity is not a schema column, so it is not filtered.
